snippet.title: Bound by Destiny - Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Store: https://saikeystudios.com/product/128888/bound-by-destiny/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=post
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3845610/Bound_by_Destiny/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=post

Control a dark dungeon as the Viber Lord, in an attempt to trap Princess Mistynail. Place and trigger traps, unleash creatures, and strike at key moments to block her path as she tries to find the exit. Prevent her escape and pave the way for your rebirth and revenge on her bloodline!
